runs.message: Make a late-night mix: atmospheric electronic music and trip-hop, a little dark and spacious, no rock or festival EDM.
runs.name: After Hours
runs.reply: A slow, spacious late-night arc that opens in the dark, drifts through the heart of Bristol trip-hop, and settles into ambient stillness. No rock, no festival EDM — everything is low-energy, reverb-heavy, and built for headphones. It moves from the iconic trip-hop sound (Massive Attack → Portishead → Hooverphonic), builds to a dark peak (Lamb), softens through Morcheeba and Moby, then dissolves into ambient darkness (Emancipator) — a natural 'lights-down' descent. If you'd prefer more artist variety, I can swap the final Emancipator for Space Shanty (Leftfield) or Passion (Nightmares on Wax).
runs.guidance: Late-night mix: atmospheric electronic and trip-hop, dark and spacious. Exclude rock, punk, metal, and festival EDM. Prefer low energy, dark/mysterious/dreamy/hypnotic moods, spacious/reverb-heavy production, late_night context. Favor variety across artists; multiple tracks from one artist acceptable when it serves the arc.
